description: This file defines classes, functions, and constants related to Prometheus metrics integration, including label sanitization, validation error classes, metric label definitions, and configuration models for filtering and managing Prometheus metrics within a Python project.

classes.name: MetricValidationError
classes.description: Error class for invalid metric names, holding the metric name and valid options.

classes.name: LabelValidationError
classes.description: Error class for invalid labels on a metric, including metric name, invalid labels, and valid labels.

classes.name: ValidationResults
classes.description: Container class for validation errors, with properties to check for errors and retrieve all error messages.

classes.name: UserAPIKeyLabelNames
classes.description: Enum defining label name constants used for user API keys and metrics labels.

classes.name: DEFINED_PROMETHEUS_METRICS
classes.description: Literal type listing all specific Prometheus metric names used in the project.

classes.name: PrometheusMetricLabels
classes.description: Class containing static methods and attributes for managing Prometheus metric labels, including label retrieval and sanitization.

classes.name: PrometheusMetricsConfig
classes.description: Pydantic model for configuring metric groups and label inclusion filters.

classes.name: PrometheusSettings
classes.description: Pydantic model for overall Prometheus metrics configuration, including multiple metric groups.

classes.name: NoOpMetric
classes.description: A dummy metric class that implements the same interface as real metrics but performs no operations.

methods.name: _sanitize_prometheus_label_name
methods.description: Sanitizes a label name to conform with Prometheus label naming rules, replacing invalid characters with underscores and ensuring valid starting characters.

methods.name: get_labels
methods.description: Static method in PrometheusMetricLabels that returns a list of labels for a given metric, including default, metadata, and tags, after sanitization.
